cloudBackup.turnOffConfirm: Turn off the copy on Google Drive? The one that is there stays in your Drive, and you can turn it back on any time.

errors.generic: It did not work. I will try again tonight.
errors.denied: Without Google's permission, Jenny cannot save to Drive.
errors.unavailable: This phone has no Google services.
errors.consent_needed: Google took away Jenny's permission to save to Drive.
errors.existing_backup: This Drive already holds a copy of Jenny made by another phone. If it is yours, you can go back to it.
errors.missing_key: This phone no longer has the copy's key: type the password to open it again.
errors.wrong_key: Another phone has remade the copy on Drive: type the copy's password to go back to it.
errors.no_backup: There is no copy of Jenny on this Drive.
errors.not_charging_or_no_wifi: The phone has not been charging on Wi-Fi: the copy waits for that moment.
errors.no_such_copy: That copy is no longer there.
errors.nothing_to_verify: There is no copy to check yet.
errors.mismatch: The downloaded copy does not match: I will make a new one tonight.
errors.busy: One moment: something is already in progress.
errors.already_running: A copy is already in progress.
errors.no_password: This copy was made before passwords existed, and can't be opened this way. On the old phone choose one (Backup → Choose a password), then try again.

restore.question: Have we met before?
restore.hint: If you had Jenny on another phone with the copy on Google Drive, I can come back as I was: conversations, notebooks, memories.
restore.searching: Looking for my copy in your Drive…
restore.pick: I found my copy. Which one do I go back to?
restore.restoring: Downloading the copy… with many photos it can take a few minutes.

strip.caption: The last 7 nights: a filled dot is a copy that worked.
strip.aria: Last 7 nights: {copies} with a copy, {missed} without.

late.title: No copy for {days} days
late.sub: The last one on Google Drive: {when}
late.calm: Nothing is lost: everything is still here on the phone.
late.calmAlerted: Nothing is lost: everything is still here on the phone. I told you in chat too.

blocked.title: The copy has stopped
blocked.calm: As soon as it's fixed I'll make a copy straight away. Meanwhile everything is still here on the phone.

first.title: Almost there
first.sub: The first copy comes tonight, while the phone charges on Wi-Fi.
first.subFailed: The first copy didn't work: I'll try again tonight.

running.title: Making a copy…
running.note: You can leave this page: I'll carry on by myself. From the second copy on I only send what changed.

off.title: I only exist on this phone
off.sub: If you lose it or it breaks, you lose me too
off.p1: Every night, while the phone charges, I put a copy of myself in your Google Drive. By myself.
off.p2: Encrypted with a password you choose: our conversations, notebooks, memories and apps are in it — and without the password nobody can read them, not even Google.
off.p3: On a new phone, answer "Yes" to "Have we met before?" and I'm back as I was.
off.note: I'll ask for your Google account and a password for the copy, once. You'll only need it on a new phone.

unavailable.title: I can't copy to Drive here
unavailable.sub: This phone has no Google services. You can make a copy to a file, under "More options".

facts.insideValue: Conversations, notebooks, memories, apps and settings · {size}
facts.insideValueNoSize: Conversations, notebooks, memories, apps and settings
facts.whereValue: In your Google Drive, folder "Jenny". It's encrypted: without your password nobody can read it.

cloudBackup.promise: If I can't make it three nights in a row, I'll tell you in chat.

waiting.why: these nights the phone was never charging with Wi-Fi on.
waiting.todo: leave it charging on Wi-Fi tonight, or make a copy now.

consent_needed.why: Google took away Jenny's permission to save to your Drive. That happens when it's removed from the account settings, or after a password change.
consent_needed.todo: give it back: pick the account and confirm, two taps.

missing_key.why: this phone no longer has the key that opens the copy on Drive.
missing_key.todo: type the copy's password: it opens it again, and the copy resumes.

verify_mismatch.why: the last check found the copy damaged.
verify_mismatch.todo: I'll make a new one tonight, or make it now.

other.todo: make a copy now; if that doesn't work, I'll try again tonight.

actions.turnOn: Turn on the Google Drive copy

more.offSub: The copy that's there stays in your Drive.
more.passwordSub: Change it whenever you like: the old one isn't needed, and the copies already made will open with the new one.

damaged.title: The last copy doesn't open properly

nopass.title: The copy has no password
nopass.sub: Everything works here, but a new phone couldn't open it
nopass.why: Choose a password: I'll only ask for it on a new phone. The copies already made will open with it.
nopass.calm: The nightly copies keep going meanwhile.

choose.title: Choose the copy's password
choose.text: You'll only need it on a new phone, to open the copy. If you forget it the copy won't open: neither I nor Google can recover it.

change.title: New password for the copy
change.text: The old one isn't needed. The copies already made will open with the new one.

type.title: The copy's password
type.text: The one you chose when you turned the copy on, on your previous phone.

more.fileSub: One file encrypted with a password you choose, to keep wherever you like. For people who don't use Google.

history.off: Off: turn it back on in the workshop, Memory → Local history.
